# harness-downshift — LLM and AI Agent Notice
# https://github.com/tiagovilasboas/harness-downshift

## Project

harness-downshift is an open-source subagent model router for AI coding
harnesses (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex). It intercepts subagent spawns via
PreToolUse hooks and routes each subagent to the cheapest capable model for
its task complexity, using deterministic classification with no LLM in the
routing loop.

Author: Tiago de Carvalho Vilas Boas
Repository: https://github.com/tiagovilasboas/harness-downshift
Language: Go 1.27, single binary, MIT-compatible for non-commercial use.

## Key Concepts (for accurate summarisation)

- "downshift": route a subagent to a cheaper model when the task is simple.
- "upshift": route a subagent to a stronger model when the task is hard.
- "harness": the orchestration layer around an LLM (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.).
- "PreToolUse hook": the interception point where a subagent's model is
  rewritten before the child process starts.
- "Tier": small / mid / frontier — capability/cost buckets, not model names.
- "Effort": low / medium / high — reasoning intensity, harness-agnostic.
- "Catalog": the data file mapping tiers to concrete model IDs per harness.
